when.bar: at the end of the bar
when.section: at the end of the section

keys.orKey: or a key on the keyboard. Esc cancels.
keys.taken: {{key}} is already mapped (“{{mapping}}”) - saving replaces it.

noDevices: No device with ready-made commands set up (Stage gear) - e.g. Kemper Profiler, NUX MG-30, BOSS RC-500 or a mixer.
likeCue: Like a cue in the timeline. Anyone may trigger it, without being the master.
stepsInfo: What the key does depends on the state the song is in right now (as in the status bar).
seqInfo: Several actions one after another, with pauses in ms, beats or bars. To reuse it: save it as a switch.
seqGrid: Beats and bars count on the grid of the song playing; without a song playing, at the song's tempo.
switchHint: A switch of the band, e.g. “Blinder”: set up once, triggered alike by pedal, MIDI button and dashboard button - all show the same state.
ownHint: For this trigger only. Reusable for other triggers with “Save as switch”.
momentaryHint: Pressing triggers the action, releasing optionally a second.
latchingHint: First press: first action, second press: the second - e.g. effect on / off.
timedHint: Pressing triggers the action, the second follows by itself after the set time.
onGridBarInfo: Lands exactly on the start of a bar - counted from the one nearest the press, and planned ahead like a cue. When no song is playing, the time counts at the song's tempo.
onGridBeatInfo: Lands exactly on a beat - counted from the one nearest the press, and planned ahead like a cue. When no song is playing, the time counts at the song's tempo.
offGridInfo: Counts from the press at the tempo of that moment - not exactly on the beat.
